freePlan.limits: The Lottie animation format and runtime libraries are open source and free; LottieFiles the platform also offers a limited free tier for browsing/hosting animations.

keyLimits.en: 2 GB storage, 10 GB CDN hosting/month, unlimited access to premium Lottie animations (250,000+), billed annually per user.
5 GB storage, 50 GB CDN hosting/month, unlimited team files, version history, feedback/comments, roles & permissions, unified admin/billing, 600 AI credits/month (vs 300 on Individual).
Custom storage and CDN hosting; built for larger teams needing more control, security, visibility and onboarding support.

cautions.en: A figure of $119.99/user/month appeared for Enterprise in one source alongside a 'contact sales' note; since Enterprise has no fixed public price, it is recorded as onQuote true rather than using that figure.
All paid plans bill annually only; no monthly billing option was found for Individual or Team.

capabilities.en: Open JSON-based format (Lottie) for lightweight, scalable vector animations that render natively on web, iOS and Android via open-source runtime libraries.
LottieFiles platform hosts, previews and lets users edit/customize a library of 250,000+ premium and free Lottie animations.
Figma plugin and other design-tool integrations for exporting animations directly as Lottie files.

limitations.en: Free tier storage/hosting is limited; scaling usage (CDN hosting, storage) requires the paid Individual or Team plan.
Team collaboration features (version history, roles & permissions, comments) are gated behind the Team plan, unavailable to Individual users.

reason.en: Competing interactive vector animation format/tool with its own runtime, targeting similar app/web animation use cases.
JavaScript animation library (GSAP) often used as an alternative to Lottie for web animation delivery.
The LottieFiles platform itself is closely tied to the Lottie format and appears as a separate catalogue entry for the hosting/editing service.

unknowns: No monthly billing option confirmed for paid plans; only annual per-seat equivalents were found.
Exact AI credit usage mechanics (what consumes a credit) not detailed in the source excerpt.
